ja: 彼女がうんと言ってたら、今ごろ食洗機があるのに。
en: If she'd said yes, we'd have a dishwasher now.
alternatives: If she'd agreed, we'd have a dishwasher by now.
If she'd agreed to it, we'd have a dishwasher now.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞、今の結果は would have

ja: 一番上の棚に届かないんだ。
en: I can't reach the top shelf.
alternatives: I can't reach the highest shelf.
The top shelf is too high.
point: 一番上の棚は特定の棚なので the top shelf と the をつける

ja: 弟はもうアイロンがけできるよ。
alternatives: My brother can iron clothes now.
My brother can already iron.
point: can の後ろは動詞の原形で irons にしない

ja: 帰る前に、おもちゃを片付けておいてね。
en: Pick up the toys before you leave.
alternatives: Put the toys away before you leave.
Clean up the toys before you go.
point: 片付ける は pick up / put away / clean up で言う

ja: 疲れてても、自分のお椀はすすいでね。
en: Even if you're tired, please rinse your bowl.
alternatives: Even when you're tired, please rinse your bowl.
Tired or not, please rinse your bowl.
point: 「〜てても」は even if。although にしない

ja: フィルター、先月から掃除されてないよ。
en: The filter hasn't been cleaned since last month.
alternatives: Nobody has cleaned the filter since last month.
The filter hasn't been cleaned for a month.
point: since があるので現在完了の受動 hasn't been cleaned

ja: 土曜、みんなでガレージを掃除するよ。
en: We're cleaning the garage this Saturday.
alternatives: We're going to clean the garage Saturday.
We'll clean the garage this Saturday.
point: 決まった予定は現在進行形でも言える

ja: 兄は先週の日曜、午後ずっと草むしりしてたよ。
en: My brother spent all last Sunday afternoon pulling weeds.
alternatives: My brother was weeding all last Sunday afternoon.
My brother spent last Sunday afternoon weeding the yard.
point: 「〜して過ごした」は spent + 時間 + -ing の形

ja: 弟に部屋を片付けるよう言ってくれる？
en: Can you tell him to clean up?
alternatives: Could you tell him to tidy up?
Can you ask him to clean up?
Will you tell him to clean up?
point: tell + 人 + to do の語順。that 節にしない

ja: お母さん、牛乳がもうないよ。
alternatives: Mom, there isn't any milk left.
Mom, we have no milk left.
Mom, we're out of milk.
point: milk は数えられないので a をつけず no milk とする

ja: 先週、うちはエアコンを業者に掃除してもらった。
en: We had the AC professionally cleaned last week.
alternatives: We got the AC professionally cleaned last week.
We had a pro clean the AC last week.
point: have + もの + 過去分詞で「〜してもらう」

ja: リサイクル、出してもらってもいい？
en: Do you mind taking out the recycling?
alternatives: Could you take out the recycling?
Would you mind taking out the recycling?
point: mind の後は動名詞。to take にしない

ja: 洗濯物を干す前に、天気予報を見ればよかった。
en: I wish I'd checked the forecast first.
alternatives: If only I'd checked the weather first.
I should have checked the forecast first.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後を過去完了 I'd checked にする

ja: 一緒にガレージを片付けたいなと思ってて。
en: I was hoping we'd clean out the garage.
alternatives: I was hoping we could clean out the garage.
I was thinking we could clear out the garage.
point: I was hoping で控えめに誘う。中身ごと片付けるは clean out

ja: ねえ、掃除機がどこにあるか知ってる？
en: Do you know where the vacuum is?
alternatives: Any idea where the vacuum is?
Do you know where the vacuum cleaner is?
point: 間接疑問は where the vacuum is の語順

ja: 僕らが早く電話してれば、お湯が使えたのにね。
en: If we'd called sooner, we'd have had hot water.
alternatives: If we'd called earlier, we'd have had hot water.
We would've had hot water if we'd called sooner.
If we'd called sooner, we could've had hot water.
point: 過去の仮定は if 節が had + 過去分詞、主節は would have
